tools.name: market_catalogue
tools.description: Discover the service: returns routes, prices and networks, plus available_days (completed news days on sale), announcement_years and feed freshness (coverage.as_of, rows). Use it to choose a tool and valid date or year inputs, not to fetch records. Free, no account or API key.

tools.name: news_sample
tools.description: Omit view for one historical scored record. Set view to delayed for up to 20 market headlines first seen at least 30 minutes ago, with publisher and capture times. The delayed preview omits scores. Both views are free.

tools.name: list_supported_coins
tools.description: Find valid filters before a coin request: returns tracked market coins with symbol and rank, plus recent news ticker counts. News tickers may be stocks or forex. Free, no account or API key.

tools.name: check_pass
tools.description: Use after buy_week_pass or buy_month_pass to check a pass key: returns status active, expired, revoked or invalid, with the plan and expiry for a genuine key. Grants no data. Free, no payment; the key is not logged.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: market_catalogue, get_latest_news, get_crypto_news · Private data: market_catalogue, news_sample, list_supported_coins, get_latest_news, get_market_signal_batch, get_crypto_news, get_latest_announcements, get_news_day, get_crypto_news_day, get_market_snapshot, get_listing_events, get_announcement_history, buy_week_pass, buy_month_pass · Public sink: buy_week_pass, buy_month_pass · Destructive: get_latest_news, get_market_signal_batch, get_crypto_news, get_latest_announcements, get_news_day, get_crypto_news_day, get_market_snapshot, get_listing_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: market_catalogue, get_latest_news, get_crypto_news · Private data: market_catalogue, news_sample, list_supported_coins, get_latest_news, get_market_signal_batch, get_crypto_news, get_latest_announcements, get_news_day, get_crypto_news_day, get_market_snapshot, get_listing_events, get_announcement_history, buy_week_pass, buy_month_pass · Public sink: buy_week_pass, buy_month_pass · Destructive: get_latest_news, get_market_signal_batch, get_crypto_news, get_latest_announcements, get_news_day, get_crypto_news_day, get_market_snapshot, get_listing_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "market_catalogue" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free routes, prices, live coverage and available archive dates." → after: "Discover the service: returns routes, prices and networks, plus available_days (completed news days on sale), announcement_years and feed freshness (coverage.as_of, rows). Use it to choose a tool and valid date or year inputs, not to fetch records. Free, no account or API key."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
